1. Engagement Scope

This compliance review focuses on wage and hour practices for Kittatinny Advisory's non-exempt workforce in 11 states. The assessment included a statistical analysis of timekeeping records for 335 employees and a review of meal and rest period policies and administration.

2. Methodology

ACPWB's methodology for assessing data privacy compliance included the use of automated data discovery tools to scan {n} network shares and databases for unstructured sensitive employee data. Findings were classified based on the NIST Privacy Framework.

4. Detailed Findings
RCR-8067-001MEDIUMREMEDIATED
Observation

Pay grade overlap exceeding policy threshold between consecutive salary bands

Corrective Action Required

The designated management official at each of the 11 establishments shall personally certify the OSHA 300A summary by the February 1st deadline annually.

Management Response

We concur. A project charter has been approved to address this finding. The project manager has been assigned, and a kickoff meeting is scheduled for {date}.

Owner: Director of Financial Reporting • Due: 2011-05-28
RCR-9678-002INFORMATIONALMONITORING
Observation

Pay grade overlap exceeding policy threshold between consecutive salary bands

Corrective Action Required

The annual open enrollment communications package will be updated to include the most current HIPAA privacy notice as a mandatory acknowledgment item for all enrolling employees.

Management Response

While we accept the factual basis of the finding, we have performed a risk assessment and formally accepted the residual risk. This decision has been documented and approved by the Chief Risk Officer. No further corrective action is planned at this time.

Owner: Senior Analyst, ESG & Sustainability • Due: 2011-02-28
RCR-8279-003INFORMATIONALMONITORING
Observation

EU Whistleblower Protection Directive transposition into local country policies is incomplete for 11 EU member states

Corrective Action Required

The 401(k) plan fiduciary committee shall formalize its vendor review process, including the issuance of RFPs and documentation of the selection rationale for all plan service providers.

Management Response

The finding is acknowledged. A cross-functional task force has been assembled to address the root cause. An initial project plan and timeline will be submitted to ACPWB within 15 days.

Owner: Chief Sustainability Officer • Due: 2011-03-28
RCR-8793-004LOWDEFERRED
Observation

System access for 335 terminated employees not revoked within the 24-hour SLA defined by IT security policy

Corrective Action Required

The proxy drafting process will include a "Disclosure Checklist" to ensure all required tables and narrative discussions under SEC Regulation S-K Item 402 are included and accurate.

Management Response

We are awaiting final evidence of remediation from the third-party vendor responsible for this process. We have received their commitment to provide the necessary documentation by 2011-01-05 and will forward it to ACPWB upon receipt.

Owner: Vice President of External Affairs • Due: 2011-05-28
RCR-9672-005MEDIUMREMEDIATED
Observation

Proxy statement CD&A omits required discussion of UK Bribery Act 2010 (corporate failure to prevent bribery offense); Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA) performance metrics

Corrective Action Required

The HRIS system logic for FMLA eligibility shall be updated to correctly account for hours worked in the 12 months preceding the leave request, including for re-hired employees.

Management Response

We concur with the finding but disagree with the "HIGH" risk rating. Based on our internal analysis, the likelihood of occurrence is low, and the potential impact is minimal. We have re-rated this finding as "LOW" in our internal GRC system and will remediate it as resources permit.

Owner: Vice President of Policy • Due: 2011-02-28
RCR-2427-006MEDIUMOPEN
Observation

Pay grade overlap exceeding policy threshold between consecutive salary bands

Corrective Action Required

The company website and all subsidiary career sites will be updated to include a compliant "Your Privacy Choices" link, and a dedicated internal team will be trained to handle data subject requests.

Management Response

Management acknowledges the finding and has initiated a preliminary review. The designated owner will oversee remediation. Kittatinny Advisory requests a 30-day extension to the original due date to allow for thorough analysis across all affected locations.

Owner: Director of Enterprise Risk • Due: 2011-02-28
